rollups.text: Home purchase and move: On 2023-08-11, the user said they were buying a $325,000 house, had Wells Fargo pre-approval for $350,000, and planned to request an additional $3,250 seller credit after the inspection found minor roof and plumbing issues; the seller had already agreed to a $2,000 credit. By 2023-11-30, the user was preparing to move into a new home, had Wells Fargo pre-approval for a $400,000 mortgage, and was arranging utilities, cable/TV, insurance, storage-unit logistics, and move tasks. The user planned to use Trello and was excited to move in and have a backyard. Elapsed time: about 111 days from the purchase discussion to move preparations.

Wells Fargo mortgage pre-approval amounts mentioned by the user changed from $350,000 on 2023-08-11 to $400,000 by 2023-11-30, an increase of $50,000. The user’s stated planned purchase price on 2023-08-11 was $325,000.

Reading for at least 20 minutes before lights out helped the user relax, reduce screen time, fall asleep more easily, and wake more easily. The user planned to limit weekend sleep-ins to 7:30 AM, try morning stretching or meditation, and considered a smart alarm. They also considered planning the day with a to-do list or goals. These were plans and strategies under consideration; no later outcome was reported.

No completed documents or commercialization outcome were reported.

They planned to try the Pomodoro Technique and Trello, remove social apps from their phone’s home screen, schedule specific checking times, and temporarily delete Facebook and Instagram apps. They also planned to unfollow, mute, and organize Twitter accounts. These were planned experiments; no later results were reported.

Suggestions about which paths should feature particular types and possible path-specific maps/events were assistant proposals, not confirmed user decisions.
